title: Taxpayer-scoped assistant service in Frappe
scope: Serve the TAX-096 taxpayer-assistance operations from Frappe: authenticate the taxpayer session, build the assistant's permission-scoped inputs (own submissions, documents, validation results, taxpayer-facing requests), call the assistant runtime, store assistant drafts and provenance, and require explicit taxpayer confirmation before anything changes a submission or is sent to RSL

acceptance.text: A taxpayer can only obtain assistance for their own tenant and records; internal-only fields never leave the service (tests); confirmation is a separate, audited, idempotent step
Confirmed submissions and evidence responses enter the existing Frappe/Jube flow (TAX-039, TAX-045) unchanged; unconfirmed drafts never do
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Confirmed submissions and evidence responses enter the existing Frappe/Jube flow (TAX-039, TAX-045) unchanged; unconfirmed drafts never do

notes.text: Added 2026-11-05 to record the agreed AI architecture (ADR-031): hosted models through a role router with local/template fallback, and the taxpayer-side assistant.
Reassigned from Edga to Keletso (single-developer delivery, ADR-038)
